title: Wildly Crisp Venezuelan Lettuce Salad
description: A refreshing herbal salad featuring crisp lettuce, yuzu cure, and ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood Venezuelan dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chilled romaine lettuce, chopped cilantro, and thinly sliced scallions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yuzu juice, olive oil, lime juice, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Drizzle the dressing over the lettuce mixture and toss to coat.
Top the salad with diced avocado.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good toss to redistribute the dressing.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Consider serving with a side of warm Venezuelan arepas for a satisfying meal.
